1.world_description:
Doom II, also known as Doom II: Hell on Earth, is a first-person shooter game by id Software.
It was released for MS-DOS in 1994.
Compared to its predecessor, Doom II features larger levels, new enemies, a new "super shotgun" weapon

2.world_description:
Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat.
Explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

tutorials.description: A guide to setting up the Satisfactory Archipelago mod and connecting it to an Archipelago Multiworld
